caption: A brick is set on top of a coil spring standing on a table, the spring compresses under it, and when the brick is lifted off the spring extends again.

sa.check: A coil spring stands on a table.
A brick is set on top of it.
The brick is set on first, then lifted, then the spring recovers.

pc.expect: The spring shortens only while the brick is on it and returns to its full height after the brick is removed.
pc.fail: It stays compressed; or does not compress; or stretches longer than it started.

pc.expect: The spring keeps its coil shape.
pc.fail: It bends sideways and stays; or splits; or melts.

pc.expect: The brick sits on top of the spring.
pc.fail: It floats; or passes through the spring; or hangs beside it.

pc.expect: The spring moves only with the brick.
pc.fail: It bounces by itself; or slides; or jumps.

pc.expect: One spring and one brick keep their number.
pc.fail: The spring duplicates; or the brick vanishes; or the spring turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The spring and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The spring changes colour; or the brick changes; or the table rearranges.
